current_screen.result: The live VUE desktop and Find Files dialog are visible. File Name contains the existing pattern a*a; no search was started and no guest data was edited.

caret_blink.result: The caret-region pixels alternated A/B/A/B/A/B without keyboard or mouse input. This proves visible blinking in the current SR10.4 field. The roughly half-second sampling intervals do not establish the exact native blink period or phase lengths.
caret_blink.gtk2_comparison: R76 remains the exact-shape comparison: VUE caret has 14-pixel stem plus 5x1-pixel terminals; GTK2 GtkEntry has a straight 1x18-pixel stem. Theme-engine limits and the decision to keep a dynamic text-role caret are documented in R63/R76. R127 does not change that implementation conclusion.

color_set.conclusion: The selected application palette is not stored in this user palette directory. Its actual source remains unresolved; do not change GTK2's role mapping based on this result.

The native selected/unselected pair remains unverified. R111's failed key sequences are not treated as proof of absence of selection.
